# Knowledge.Deck.no

> > An AI-categorized directory of human knowledge spanning science, humanities, social sciences, and practical domains with intelligent taxonomy and content organization.

Knowledge.Deck.no is a comprehensive knowledge base organized into 16 major subject categories, powered by AI categorization and designed to help users discover and navigate information across all disciplines. The site uses an intelligent taxonomy structure to organize articles, research, and educational content ranging from hard sciences to cultural studies.

## Key Topics

- Physics
- Chemistry
- Biology
- Computer Science
- Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil)
- Environmental Science
- Mathematics
- Psychology and Sociology
- Economics and Finance
- History and Culture
- Philosophy and Ethics
- Law and Politics
- Education and Learning
- Biotechnology
- Robotics and Automation

## Core Knowledge Categories

- [Science and Technology](https://knowledge.deck.no/science-and-technology): Category index for physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, and tech
- [Mathematics](https://knowledge.deck.no/mathematics): Category index covering algebra, geometry, calculus, and statistics
- [Health and Medicine](https://knowledge.deck.no/health-and-medicine): Category index for anatomy, physiology, pharmacology, and healthcare
- [Economics and Finance](https://knowledge.deck.no/economics-and-finance): Category index for macro/microeconomics, finance, and investment
- [Psychology and Sociology](https://knowledge.deck.no/psychology-and-sociology): Category index for psychology, sociology, behavior, and social dynamics

## History, Geography & Social Sciences

- [History](https://knowledge.deck.no/history): Category index spanning ancient to modern history and cultural periods
- [Geography](https://knowledge.deck.no/geography): Category index for physical geography, GIS, geology, and geopolitics
- [Law and Politics](https://knowledge.deck.no/law-and-politics): Category index for law, political systems, governance, and relations
- [Cultural Studies and Anthropology](https://knowledge.deck.no/cultural-studies-and-anthropology): Category index for cultural theory, anthropology, archaeology, ethnography
- [Judicial Powers](https://knowledge.deck.no/law-and-politics/constitutional-law/judicial-powers): Article on judicial powers, courts, and separation of powers

## Humanities, Arts & Philosophy

- [Philosophy and Ethics](https://knowledge.deck.no/philosophy-and-ethics): Category index for philosophical theories, ethics, logic, and schools
- [Art and Literature](https://knowledge.deck.no/art-and-literature): Category index for art history, visual arts, literature, and film
- [Languages and Linguistics](https://knowledge.deck.no/languages-and-linguistics): Category index for languages, linguistics theory, and language learning

## Education, Business & Environment

- [Education and Learning](https://knowledge.deck.no/education-and-learning): Category index for pedagogy, learning theories, and educational systems
- [Business and Management](https://knowledge.deck.no/business-and-management): Category index for business, entrepreneurship, and organizational behavior
- [Environment and Ecology](https://knowledge.deck.no/environment-and-ecology): Category index for ecosystems, conservation, sustainability, and climate

## Discovery & Navigation

- [Directory of Human Knowledge](https://knowledge.deck.no): Homepage: AI-categorized directory for discovering knowledge across all topics
- [Latest Articles](https://knowledge.deck.no/latest): Index of latest articles across multiple knowledge categories
- [Entertainment and Leisure](https://knowledge.deck.no/entertainment-and-leisure): Category index for sports, hobbies, gaming, tourism, and recreation

## Optional

- [Micropaleontology](https://knowledge.deck.no/random): Article on micropaleontology, microfossils, and biostratigraphy
